historical_coverage: Horizon Europe and Horizon 2020 project factsheets; partial FP7 coverage
known_limitations: no documented developer API: the public search front end calls an unauthenticated JSON endpoint that can change without notice
the search index returns 'result' report documents, not projects; project factsheets must be resolved via the associated project id and then fetched individually (2 requests per project)
fielded query syntax is undocumented and fails silently: a numeric query returned HTTP 500, and 'contenttype=project' as a query was ignored
contentCreationDate is when the CORDIS record was created, not a formal publication date; ecSignatureDate is the award decision
rate_limits: undocumented JSON endpoints; no published limit (we paced at 1.2s)
research_value: The only public record of EU research money and consortium membership; a deterministic way to see whether a European device firm participates in funded consortia, with CC-BY reuse.
